# Lowest-supported direct dependency profile for CPython 3.9 on Linux.
#
# Most entries are the exact lower bound declared in setup.py. Three coupled
# packages intentionally use the first installable set rather than mutually
# impossible independent floors:
#   torch 2.1.0 + torchvision 0.16.0 require sympy 1.12;
#   cellpose 4.0.7 is setup.py's declared floor, NOT the first 4.x
#     release. This file used to pin 4.0.1 on the reasoning that it was
#     the first published 4.x, which stopped being the point when the
#     floor was raised: CellposeModel's signature differs between them
#     (use_bfloat16 absent in 4.0.1, resample defaulting True rather
#     than None), so the min-deps job was installing a version the
#     package declares it does not support and failing ~23 tests that
#     pass on every other job;
#   umap-learn 0.5.11 requires scikit-learn 1.6 or newer;
#   tensorboard 2.21.0 requires protobuf 6.31.1 or newer.
#
# statsmodels and shap used to be the same failure the cellpose note below
# describes, in the other direction: the pin matched setup.py exactly and
# SETUP.PY was the file that was wrong. 0.13.5 and 0.45.0 were floors nobody
# had run, and this job is what ran them -- 16 failures no other job had,
# all of them an API spaCR uses that the pinned release does not have.
# setup.py now declares statsmodels>=0.14.0 and shap>=0.47.0 with the reason
# written next to each, and tests/test_dependency_floors_have_the_api.py
# keeps the two facts joined. Both versions publish cp39 wheels.
#
# Dependencies with no declared lower bound (czifile and readlif) are left to
# pip. This file constrains direct dependencies only; transitive packages are
# resolved normally so their own compatibility metadata remains authoritative.
